sub_strands.name: Squares, Square Roots, and Cubes
performance_indicators: Find squares and square roots of perfect squares and fractions using factorization methods.
Determine the cubes and cube roots of numbers up to 1,000 using estimation and mathematical tables.
Apply standard order of operations (BODMAS) to solve complex arithmetic problems involving fractions and decimals.

sub_strands.name: Commercial Arithmetic
performance_indicators: Calculate compound interest on investments and loans over a given multi-year duration manually.
Solve problems involving hire purchase transactions, calculating deposit totals and monthly installments.

sub_strands.name: Surface Area, Pyramids, and Probability
performance_indicators: Calculate the total surface area of right pyramids and triangular prisms using spatial nets.
Collect, organize, and represent discrete data using frequency distribution tables and pie charts.
Determine the experimental and theoretical probability of single-event outcomes accurately.

sub_strands.name: Simultaneous Equations and Loci
performance_indicators: Formulate and solve pairs of simultaneous linear equations using elimination and substitution methods.
Construct the perpendicular bisector of a line and the angle bisector using a ruler and compasses.
Investigate and describe the constant locus of a point moving at a fixed distance from a specific node.

sub_strands.name: Active Listening and Interview Dynamics
performance_indicators: Conduct structured interviews using open-ended questions, active response tracking, and correct posture.
Distinguish between facts, logical deductions, and emotional biases during complex verbal presentations.

sub_strands.name: Critical Set Text Analysis and Poetry
performance_indicators: Analyze full-length junior novels to chart thematic motifs, stylistic devices, and character growth timelines.
Deconstruct structural rhyme schemes, alliteration, and thematic imagery inside selected regional poems.

sub_strands.name: Advanced Grammar and Functional Composition
performance_indicators: Incorporate active/passive voice shifts and relative pronouns to enhance clarity across written scripts.
Write functional, structured compositions including minutes of meeting formats, formal speech outlines, and brief investigative reports.

sub_strands.name: Hotuba na Majadiliano Rasmi
performance_indicators: Kusikiliza hotuba rasmi na kubainisha mada kuu, malengo, na mbinu za ushawishi zilizotumiwa.
Kuhutubia darasa au hadhara fupi kwa kutumia matamshi bora, lafudhi safi, na ulinganifu wa kiitikadi.

sub_strands.name: Ufahamu na Ushairi wa Kiswahili
performance_indicators: Kusoma na kuchambua mashairi ya arudhi (kwa mfano, miundo ya mishororo, vipande, na vina) na mashairi huru.
Kufafanua ujumbe, maadili, na tamathali za usemi zilizomo katika tamthilia na hadithi fupi za Kiswahili.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa Kina na Unyambulishaji
performance_indicators: Kuandika insha za upambanuzi (mijadala) na barua rasmi za mwaliko kwa usahihi na muundo unaofaa.
Kutumia mnyambuliko wa vitenzi (kwa mfano, kauli ya kutendea, kutendewa, kutendana) katika ngeli mbalimbali.

sub_strands.name: Chemical Symbols, Equations, and Kinetic Theory
performance_indicators: Write and balance simple word and chemical equations for combustion and neutralization reactions.
Explain the kinetic theory of matter using models of particle arrangement during thermal expansion.
Demonstrate safety protocols when handling hot, reactive, or corrosive chemicals in the laboratory setup.

sub_strands.name: Human Nervous System and Sense Organs
performance_indicators: Illustrate the structural pathway of a simple reflex arc involving sensory, relay, and motor neurons.
Examine the structure of the human eye and ear, detailing common defects and corrective strategies.

sub_strands.name: Linear Motion, Speed, and Velocity
performance_indicators: Differentiate between scalar and vector quantities, explicitly focusing on distance, displacement, speed, and velocity.
Investigate friction factors and outline structural engineering processes used to control drag and wear.

sub_strands.name: Orthographic Projection and Power Tools
performance_indicators: Interpret and draw simple three-view orthographic projections of block targets in first angle projection.
Demonstrate safety operational layouts for using mechanical drills, basic saws, and joining equipment safely.
Compare the electrical properties of conductors, semiconductors, and insulation materials cleanly.

sub_strands.name: Computer Networks and Conditional Logic
performance_indicators: Differentiate between Local Area Networks (LAN) and Wide Area Networks (WAN) infrastructure setups.
Design structured block-based scripts incorporating conditional statements (IF-THEN-ELSE) to execute workflows.

sub_strands.name: Ledger Accounts and Trial Balance
performance_indicators: Post daily business transactions from primary source documents into double-entry T-ledger accounts.
Extract balancing details from financial ledgers to construct a clean, accurate business Trial Balance.

sub_strands.name: Water Harvesting and Soil Fertility
performance_indicators: Design and construct small-scale farm runoff water harvesting channels and check dams.
Analyze nutrient deficiency indicators in crops and determine targeted organic replenishment methods.
Practice systemic agroforestry methods by integrating fruit or timber crops within active farm parcels.

sub_strands.name: Bee and Poultry Husbandry
performance_indicators: Execute seasonal hive management steps including swarm control and safe honey extraction mechanics.
Formulate balanced poultry feed allocations incorporating correct protein, mineral, and carbohydrate ratios.

sub_strands.name: First Aid and Advanced Laundry Work
performance_indicators: Demonstrate appropriate emergency first aid responses for severe burns, choking, and animal bites.
Perform comprehensive laundry care processes for specific delicate fibers including woolens and silks.

sub_strands.name: Climatic Regions of Africa and Settlement Patters
performance_indicators: Analyze the key factors influencing climatic variations across the African continent.
Evaluate the relationship between environmental climate zones and historical human population density adjustments.
Interpret topographic maps to deduce drainage networks, vegetation patterns, and transport linkages.

sub_strands.name: Scramble for Africa and Colonial Rule
performance_indicators: Examine the motives behind the European scramble and partition of the African continent.
Contrast direct and indirect colonial administrative systems implemented in select African nations.
Outline the structure, functions, and check-and-balance parameters of the Kenyan Judiciary arm.

sub_strands.name: National Values and Human Rights
performance_indicators: Evaluate national values and principles of governance highlighted in Article 10 of the Constitution of Kenya.
Demonstrate critical problem-solving, stress management, and empathetic peer support attributes inside team activities.

sub_strands.name: Advanced Visual Media and Ornamentation
performance_indicators: Create structural three-dimensional sculptures utilizing local wire armatures and clay modeling overlays.
Produce complex patterns on flat surfaces using multi-block relief printmaking procedures.
Design functional contemporary leather items or synthetic ornaments applying manual stitching metrics.

sub_strands.name: Melodic Writing and Script Execution
performance_indicators: Write simple melodic phrases onto standard musical staff layouts using basic key signature frames.
Perform narrative play scripts or dramatized choral acts showcasing clear blocking and vocal delivery control.

sub_strands.name: Field Events and Sports Mechanics
performance_indicators: Execute technical mechanics for triple jump sequence limits and javelin run-up and release phases safely.
Demonstrate defensive and offensive positioning systems within specific competitive team games (e.g., basketball, rugby).

sub_strands.name: Prophetic Messages and Personal Virtues
performance_indicators: Examine social justice issues condemned by Old Testament prophets like Amos and apply lessons to local setups.
Analyze biblical paradigms concerning responsible execution of freedom and personal choices.
Demonstrate critical loyalty and ethical integrity when responding to challenging contemporary social trends.

sub_strands.name: Quranic Chapters and Pillars of Islam
performance_indicators: Translate and apply the core moral directives highlighted within Surah Al-Alaq and Surah Ad-Duha.
Analyze the spiritual, social, and physical benefits of observing mandatory Sawm (fasting) during Ramadan.
Demonstrate Islamic standard behaviors regarding property care, contract fulfillment, and general financial fairness.
